references.text: God says he will hide his face from the people because of their unfaithfulness and turn away from them.
The Lord says he will hide his face from the house of Jacob because they have turned away from him.
Sins separate the people from God, and he hides his face from them because of their wrongdoing.
God hides his face and lets the people wither away because of their sins.
God explains that he hid his face from Israel because of their unfaithfulness and transgressions.
The prophet warns that God will hide his face from those who do evil.
God refuses to go with the people because they are a stiff-necked people, showing the consequence of their sin.
The context explains that the people will turn to other gods, and God's anger will lead him to hide his face.
David asks God not to hide his face or reject his servant in anger.
The psalmist asks God not to hide his face, for he is in distress.
